sources.entry: KDP Readiness Score - Free 60-second pre-flight audit for indie authors. Runs the 30+ technical checks Amazon's KDP review system uses (margins, bleed, font embedding, image DPI, ToC integrity, ISBN match, EPUB validity) and returns a score plus remediation PDF. No signup. Disclosure: submitted by the maker.

summary.name: KDP Readiness Score
summary.one_liner: A free 60-second pre-flight audit that checks a KDP manuscript PDF against 30+ technical rules and returns a /100 score with flagged issues.
keywords: will my book pass kdp review
use_cases: Checking a KDP print PDF before uploading to Amazon
Finding formatting errors that could cause KDP rejection
Verifying ISBN and trim size match across files
Validating an EPUB before publishing on Kindle
Getting a remediation list for manuscript fixes
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a free audit where a user uploads a manuscript PDF and the tool runs 30+ checks it says mirror Amazon's KDP review. Checks listed include margins and gutter width, image DPI against a 300 DPI minimum, font embedding, table of contents links, blank pages and page-count rules, ISBN in metadata versus the copyright page, bleed, spine width, and EPUB validation. The result is a /100 score with each failure flagged and a per-file PDF report; the page says the score is emailed. The page also lists two related free tools for books already on Amazon: a conversion scorecard using an Amazon URL and an AI discovery score that queries ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
notable: Runs 30+ checks described as matching Amazon KDP's review, returning a /100 score and per-file report
Says uploads are scanned on a UK server, not sent to third-party AI providers, and auto-deleted after 24 hours
Gutter recommendation scales by page count, from 0.375" for 24-150pp up to 0.875" for 700-828pp
caveats: Page describes the checks as matching Amazon's system but this is the maker's own claim
Listing was submitted by the maker, per the disclosure
